timeline_configuration.wait_policy: native fastest default; no low-spin override
timeline_configuration.profiler: NVIDIA Nsight Systems2025.5.2 CUDA+NVTX, CPU sampling/context-switch tracing disabled
timeline_configuration.identity_method: Exact opaque tensor pointer keys within private process, not generic tensor names.
timeline_configuration.cpu_affinity: Original unpinned runtime; fixed-CCD calibration is not substituted for the production placement.

oracle_assumptions.scope: Next-demand opportunity bound, not a global multi-layer cache scheduler optimum.
window_families: GPU kernels outside all CPU graph/observer ranges
GPU kernels/copies outside all CPU graph/observer ranges, DMA-debited
GPU kernels/copies excluding expert CPU/observer ranges, DMA-debited
oracle_assumptions.perfect_oracle: Exact next demand known after previous nonempty CPU expert graph; impossible future knowledge is explicit.
oracle_assumptions.fresh_ids: Current native cold IDs after the preceding CPU producer graph finishes.
oracle_assumptions.pre_admission: Snapshot at current dispatch graph entry: real selected IDs and current slot map; later admissions are false positives.
oracle_assumptions.previous_cold_control: Only prior same-projection native cold IDs, staged in deterministic prior-ID order without future filtering.
oracle_assumptions.cache_retention: Ideal per-next-graph capacity only, no associativity/replacement/pollution model.
oracle_assumptions.bandwidth_model: Uniform observed CUDA copy rate debits one host read/write pass, two for host-host copies; no read/write turnaround penalty.

cache_calibration.scope: Original real-weight selected GPT-OSS slices, synthetic one-row activation and uniform selected probabilities; unchanged native CPU FFN.
cache_calibration.source_buffers: Owned CPU graph tensor copies; original model files/mappings are not flushed or modified.
cache_calibration.warming: One 8-byte load per64-byte cacheline, bounded prefix of gate/up/down buffers in graph order; no extra model copy.
cache_calibration.cold_control: CLFLUSH on those owned projection buffers only.
cache_calibration.paired_order: Alternates cold/warm first within each invocation; reversed case order on middle repeat.

short_corpus_profiler_full_logit_preserv.scope: Separate short held-out corpus; observer qualification only, not a live staging candidate.

decision.immediate_current_route_prefetch: No-go for live implementation from current evidence; too little eligible payload before CPU demand.
decision.previous_cold_predictor: No-go for scheduler implementation; poor staged-byte precision.
decision.general_early_prediction_staging: Conditional research candidate, not disproven by these baseline hints.
decision.next_gate: Demonstrate earlier causal, byte-costed hints under native residency/admission before implementing a live same-CCD warmer.
decision.deployment_recommendation: No new Synapse settings or runtime/kernel changes from this study.

limitations: Four short128-output traces, one machine, profile perturbation and no repeat confidence interval for timeline headroom.
No cache hit/miss hardware counters: observed cold/warm effects and logical byte models, not measured LLC occupancy.
Calibration uses pinned singleCCD compute and synthetic activations; native runtime remains unpinned and dynamically resident.
Whole64MiB budget is an ideal sensitivity scenario, not a recommendation to aggregate physically separate CCD caches.
No actual overlapping GPU/CPU warmer, learned predictor, per-token speedup or60tok/s result.
Original model weight hashes remain historical identity evidence; no fresh full59GiB rehash.

tooling.historical_provenance_note: Earlier V1/V2/V3 traces and reports retain their actual source hashes/schema; only identity-qualified final reports are aggregated.
